BiblicalUsage: Adamah was a town in Naphtali, named once in the list of the tribe's fenced cities, alongside Ramah and Hazor. As a place, Adamah is covered in the Biblical Places collection rather than in a biography.
TheologicalSignificance: A town's name teaches nothing by itself. The list keeps it because the land was divided town by town, and every town was counted.
